$comment: Acceptance corpus for the MK2 → MK3 converted extensions (OPUS-MK2-01 task B, OPUS-MK2-02 task G). `extension` is a directory under `extensions/`. A `real` sample is a path relative to the MK2 checkout (MODKITX_MK2_ROOT, default ../modkitx) and is READ ONLY — no sample is ever copied into this repository; those cases are skipped when that checkout is absent, so CI without MK2 stays green. A `synthetic` sample is a file in test/fixtures/mk2-synthetic, written from the format specification by scripts/gen-synthetic-corpus.mjs; those cases always run and prove structural opening, not fidelity.
